title: VooPoo PnP X Pod Tank (MTL)
description: The Voopoo PnP X Tank MTL version offers a dedicated Mouth-To-Lung vaping experience. Crafted for those who love the nuances of flavour and a more discreet vapour output, this tank is a perfect addition to any MTL vaper's arsenal. With its sturdy construction combining PCTG and Stainless Steel, it is not only robust but also stylish. This tank has a 2ml e-liquid capacity, providing ample space for your preferred e-liquids. The unique MTL drip tip is designed to enhance the flavour delivery and provide a comfortable, satisfying draw. Refilling is convenient with the side-filling design, ensuring a mess-free experience. The tank's compatibility with the PnP X series coils means you have various options to customize your vaping experience, making it versatile for different preferences. In the kit, you'll find two coils: a 0.6ohm coil for an optimal MTL experience and 0.3ohm coil offering a more flexible vaping DTL style. This adaptability makes the PnP X Tank MTL version a great choice for vapers who appreciate the subtlety of MTL vaping but want the flexibility to experiment. The Voopoo PnP X Tank MTL distinguishes itself with its specialized drip tip and precise airflow control, making it an ideal choice for those who seek a flavour-focused vaping journey. Launched with the Voopoo Drag X2 and S2 pod kits, the PnP X Pod tank’s 510 connector makes it compatible with a wide variety of vape mods. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
